queries_used.note: source_metadata contains: imageDate, indexType, scaleM, validPixels, cloudyPixelPercentage, vmin, vmax, method, nZonesActual

transformations_applied: Coordinate conversion: [lat,lng] → GeoJSON [lng,lat] for field boundary polygon
Zone polygon: exported as-is from management_zones.polygon_geojson (MultiPolygon, EPSG:4326)
NDVI mean (metadata): area-weighted average computed from 6-zone statistics
No values modified, rounded, or recomputed — all figures match production DB exactly

data_anonymization.note: Name replaced and account ID omitted; parcel geometry preserved.

notes_on_data_cleaning: NDVI timeseries contains only one observation (2026-04-26) — no temporal series available for this field at extraction time.
Field registered area (13.23 ha) differs from zone-computed area (12.7263 ha) due to rasterization at 10m pixel resolution — normal discrepancy for irregular polygons.
Zone min/max NDVI values not stored in DB per-zone; only field-level vmin/vmax from source_metadata are available.
Prescription amounts (total_kg) computed as dose_per_ha × area_ha, rounded to 2 decimal places by the platform.
reproducibility_guarantee: Numeric results preserved from the historical export; identifying fields were redacted.
